decks.title: Medical flashcards (MedAlpaca)

licence.name: cc, variant not specified on the dataset card

decks.attribution: UNVERIFIED PROVENANCE. Derived from medalpaca/medical_meadow_medical_flashcards (Han et al., MedAlpaca, 2023), whose rows the authors derived from a community-made Anki medical curriculum deck and rephrased with GPT-3.5. The dataset card lists the licence as "cc" without a variant, so redistribution rights are unclear. Questions converted to runner format by an AI and checked automatically; not reviewed by a clinician.
decks.author: Han et al. (MedAlpaca, 2023); runner conversion by Dx Dash

decks.title: MedMCQA essentials

licence.name: Apache-2.0 (as listed on the dataset card)

decks.attribution: Adapted from MedMCQA: A Large-scale Multi-Subject Multi-Choice Dataset for Medical domain Question Answering. Pal A, Umapathi LK, Sankarasubbu M. Proceedings of the Conference on Health, Inference, and Learning (CHIL), PMLR 174, 2022. Dataset openlifescienceai/medmcqa on Hugging Face, licence Apache-2.0 as listed on the dataset card. Questions are exam questions compiled from Indian medical entrance exams, rewritten into runner format by an AI and checked automatically; provenance of the original questions is unclear and the cards have not been verified for exam accuracy by a clinician.
decks.author: Pal, Umapathi and Sankarasubbu (MedMCQA); runner cards generated by Dx Dash
